passives.name: EnelEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
At {1} $EnelMeter stacks:
- Summon a $LightningStrike at this unit's position
- Reset $EnelMeter
On $LightningStrike:
- Deal {2}% of this unit's current damage and apply $Electricity to all enemies in this unit's range
- Leave $ElectricResidue on the ground that will despawn after {3} seconds
$ElectricResidue will:
- Keep $Electricity permanently active on enemy until enemy has left range or it has despawned

passives.name: EnelEquipmentPassive2
passives.description:
Every {1} seconds:
- Apply $Golden to {2} enemies in range
$Golden will:
- Stun an enemy for {3} seconds
- Increase chain lightning hits from $Electricity to an additional {4} enemies
